verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms three.js ships WebGL/WebGPU renderers and PBR-capable materials (MeshStandardMaterial/MeshStandardNodeMaterial) plus a modern shader system (TSL), and community feedback confirms it's a capable rendering abstraction used for real games. However, the pack contains no explicit documentation of shadow mapping, baked lighting/GI, or a post-processing pipeline, and one community comment even questions whether lightmap/GI generation is supported. missing for 10: explicit shadow-map docs, GI/baked-lighting support, post-processing pipeline evidence, independent confirmation of production-quality visual output.
